the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The section e : U to R of s is an immersion (schemes section-immersion lemma). In the displayed diagram, the square with (1, i) on top and e at the bottom is cartesian because a composed with b = e forces b = i(a); the composition of the two horizontal maps is the diagonal morphism of t : R to U, and the right top horizontal arrow is an isomorphism. Since Omega_{R/U} is the conormal sheaf of the composition, it is isomorphic to the conormal sheaf of (1, i); the conormal functoriality lemma for flat base changes then yields the canonical surjection t^*C_{U/R} to Omega_{R/U}, an isomorphism when c is flat; and c is a base change of s by the properties of the pullback diagram (equation-pull), so flatness of s implies flatness of c by the base-change-flat lemma.
